subject: Sirocco status: synthetic MMD parity, fuzzing track slower
body:
Hi Dmitri, Ivo,

Status. Synthetic track is done: after 500 epochs on the varlen configs, held-out MMD under the hamming kernel matches the published numbers within noise, and the learned heat maps look right under plot phase. Linear-kernel MMD is slightly better than reported, likely a seed effect.

Risk on the fuzzing track. Getting usable raw seed inputs out of the LibFuzzer setup is taking Bilal much longer than scoped — the docker build and seed extraction are two weeks in with partial coverage on three targets. Sampling itself is fine; it's the corpus plumbing. If this doesn't converge by early July, I'd rather cut the fuzzing demo than have a half-evaluated claim in the readout.

Hyun
